title: Earth, off the shortlist

model.formula: unit(mean(unit(scenic)) - mean(unit(ordinary))); score = unit(pooled_embedding) dot weight + intercept
model.parity_correction: Per 256x256 block, subtract the four parity means relative to their grand mean before pooling.

metrics.validation: Leave one geographic group out; all labels in each group held out. Bootstrap is by seed, not a population confidence interval.

limitations: Subjective, hand-curated labels; 30 landmarks, 30 developed controls and 30 ordinary open-land controls are a small convenience sample.
Labels can reflect land cover, region and water rather than aesthetic quality. Separate scenic-versus-open-land held-out metrics are reported; no human candidate preference study.
Candidates are unlabelled grid cells, not verified destinations. Hidden means at least 5 km from all training examples, not low visitor counts.
No access, ownership, safety, trail, ecological sensitivity or popularity assessment. Satellite imagery on the site can be newer than 2025 embeddings.
Four deliberately chosen western-US search regions; no global coverage claim. 160 m pooled footprints cannot resolve a viewpoint or trail.
